name: Universal TV Reduce Motion
description: Reduces all motion and animations for a smoother TV browsing experience on lower-end hardware

params.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; } } .animated, [class*='animate'], [class*='Animate'], [class*='motion'], [class*='Motion'], [class*='fade-'], [class*='slide-'], [class*='bounce'], [class*='pulse'] { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
